regression_results.assertion_summary: Verified EXPLAIN execution plans on native indexes (idx_cat_filter, PRIMARY) and validated selective catalog filter and facet calculation DB p95 latencies within budget
Verified keyset pagination executes with O(1) compound index lookup (idx_cat_filter) and deep page traversal DB p95 remains strictly within budget
Verified concurrent keyset backfill and import write load does not regress storefront checkout latency; zero oversell and idempotency verified
Verified streaming catalog traversal maintains bounded flat memory consumption far below the 256 MiB worker budget
Verified warm cache delivers strong speedup and atomic mutex stampede protection prevents duplicate database queries under concurrency

acceptance.observation: Ngưỡng ở phần 9/07 §6 được chốt trên baseline; critical p95 không suy giảm >10% proposed budget (catalog 48 filter <= 100ms, facets <= 250ms, keyset deep <= 100ms, checkout <= 50ms, RAM <= 256 MiB)
Index query speed được directly measured bằng microtime timers qua nhiều iterations, báo cáo đầy đủ p50/p95/p99/min/max thay vì suy diễn từ row count
Báo cáo storage footprint chi tiết cho retained shells/meta và phân tích slow unsupported legacy queries (filesort và temporary tables do unindexed postmeta)
